properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): a refused typed write is not atomic. 13 typed constructors store the node, then check optional enums, link items or edge types in later writes with no batch around the call, so the refusal leaves the node. On a revise, add_capability's refusal says "nothing was written" after the body was overwritten. The corrected retry counts as a revise, so the duplicate guard and the relatedness refusal never run
